# v1.6.2 — Mobile notifications connect and recover reliably

- Fixed production mobile clients receiving no ntfy WebSocket URL: the backend now accepts `NTFY_BASE_URL` as a fallback to `NTFY_PUBLIC_URL`, preserving the existing preferred variable.
- Filtered ntfy envelope events so only actual messages create system notifications; open, keepalive, and other control events are ignored.
- Added WebSocket reconnection with exponential backoff (5 seconds up to 5 minutes).
- Added **Provjeri vezu** in mobile settings to diagnose missing server URL/topic and WebSocket/proxy problems.

## Verification

- Flutter analysis/tests passed and a release APK was built (53 MB); the local stack was rebuilt on v1.6.2.
